Include subsystem code in the existing fuzzy keyword predicate.

commands.salient_output: Vue type-check passed; Vite transformed 2362 modules and built production assets with only the existing chunk-size warning.
11-module reactor package completed successfully and rebuilt the boot archive.

local_checks.evidence: Empty focus showed 3 candidates; typing AUTH/auth or rapid prior text kept 3 main rows; selection reduced the list to one; clear restored 3.
Focused test passed, direct API returned SQ-202608-002 for AUTH, and browser returned the same candidate after backend restart.
Window, application, baseline and production controls each showed scoped options, fuzzy matched declared fields, preserved rows during typing and applied real selection.
limitations: Current test data contains 1 window, 3 applications, 2 baseline entries and 1 production entry, below the 20-option cap.

local_checks.evidence: Switching from P-RDDMP-UPGRADE to P-CORE-MODERN cleared the selected production entry and yielded 0 rows; switching back restored project data without restoring the stale selection.
No page warning or error logs were captured after the final interaction matrix.

diff_summary: Replaced the final plain list search with the shared selection-only candidate control.
Added independent remote candidate state with 300ms debounce and generation-based stale-response suppression.
Corrected the existing release application keyword predicate to cover subsystem code and added a focused test.
